optimus_princeps.name: Optimus Princeps
optimus_princeps.description: Tries to include as much territory as possible in their empire. Does not like civilizations who control little territory.

queen_of_the_nile.name: Queen of the Nile
queen_of_the_nile.description: Likes civilizations with powerful armies. Dislikes civilizations with weak ones.

delian_league.name: Delian League
delian_league.description: Likes civilizations that aren't competing for the same city-state allegiance. Dislikes civilizations that are directly competing for city-state allegiance.

wonder_obsessed.name: Wonder Obsessed
wonder_obsessed.description: Likes civilizations not competing for wonders, and builds wonders whenever possible. Dislikes losing a wonder to another civilization.

ally_of_enkidu.name: Ally of Enkidu
ally_of_enkidu.description: Likes civilizations who are willing to form a long-term alliance. Dislikes anyone denouncing or attacking his friends and allies.

tlatoani.name: Tlatoani
tlatoani.description: Likes civilizations who have the same Luxury resources as he does, and will try to collect every Luxury resource available. Dislikes civilizations who have a new Luxury resource he has not yet collected.

city_planner.name: City Planner
city_planner.description: Always tries to keep the maximum number of districts in each city. Respects other civilizations who also develop their cities in this fashion.

backstab_averse.name: Backstab Averse
backstab_averse.description: Likes civilizations who are their declared friend. Hates civilizations who backstab and declare surprise wars.

iron_crown.name: Iron Crown
iron_crown.description: Believes city-states belong under the crown, not courted. Dislikes civilizations that make themselves Suzerain of them.

cheomseongdae.name: Cheomseongdae
cheomseongdae.description: Pursues the stars and the sciences. Admires civilizations with a strong Science output and thinks little of those without one.

westernizer.name: Westernizer
westernizer.description: Looks west for what he lacks. Friendly toward civilizations ahead of him in Science and Culture, and dislikes those that have fallen behind.

horn_chest_loins.name: Horn, Chest, Loins
horn_chest_loins.description: Fights in formations and expects others to. Respects civilizations that field Corps and Armies, and thinks little of those that do not.

solitary.name: Solitary
solitary.description: Keeps her cities close and her neighbours far. Approves of civilizations that settle at a distance and resents those that crowd her.

scourge_of_rome.name: Scourge of Rome
scourge_of_rome.description: Counts a civilization by the men it can field. Respects large armies and holds small ones in contempt.

lord_of_the_mines.name: Lord of the Mines
lord_of_the_mines.description: Measures a civilization by its treasury. Respects those who make Gold and thinks little of those who do not.

sicilian_wars.name: Sicilian Wars
sicilian_wars.description: Wants the coast to herself. Approves of civilizations that keep to the interior and resents those that crowd the shore.

sun_never_sets.name: Sun Never Sets
sun_never_sets.description: Means to plant a flag on every shore. Warms to civilizations that share her continent and cools toward those on continents where England has no city.

divine_guardian.name: Divine Guardian
divine_guardian.description: Counts the faithful. Favours civilizations that follow his religion and looks coldly on those that do not.

defender_of_the_homeland.name: Defender of the Homeland
defender_of_the_homeland.description: Never forgives a civilization that has declared war on her, and thinks well of those that never have.

enthusiastic_disciple.name: Enthusiastic Disciple
enthusiastic_disciple.description: Likes civilizations that bring their religion to the Kongo. Dislikes a civilization that founded a religion and never carried it to a Kongolese city.

patron_of_the_arts.name: Patron of the Arts
patron_of_the_arts.description: Likes civilizations that are not competing for Great People, and recruits Great People whenever possible. Dislikes losing a Great Person to another civilization.

last_viking_king.name: Last Viking King
last_viking_king.description: Builds a large navy and respects civilizations that follow his lead. Thinks little of a civilization with a weak navy.

short_life_of_glory.name: Short Life of Glory
short_life_of_glory.description: Likes civilizations at war with a major power other than Macedon. Has disdain for a civilization at peace.

saint.name: Saint
saint.description: Builds up Faith, and likes civilizations that also make Faith their business.

bushido.name: Bushido
bushido.description: Likes a civilization strong in arms and in Faith and Culture alike. Has no time for one that is strong in arms and poor in both.

big_stick_policy.name: Big Stick Policy
big_stick_policy.description: Likes a civilization that keeps a city on his own continent and keeps the peace there. Dislikes one that starts a war on it.

ayyubid_dynasty.name: Ayyubid Dynasty
ayyubid_dynasty.description: Wants his Worship building in as many cities as possible, and likes a civilization that has one. Dislikes a civilization following another religion.

horse_lord.name: Horse Lord
horse_lord.description: Means to keep the world’s finest cavalry. Likes a civilization that does not compete for it, and dislikes one that rivals him.

navigators_legacy.name: Navigator's Legacy
navigators_legacy.description: Appreciates a civilization that goes out and sees the world, and thinks little of one that stays close to its own borders.

lawgiver.name: Lawgiver
lawgiver.description: Keeps his citizens content and loyal, and is impressed by a civilization that manages the same.

raven_banner.name: Raven Banner
raven_banner.description: Levies troops from city-states, and likes a civilization that does the same. Thinks little of one that shuns such mercenaries.

bibliophile.name: Bibliophile
bibliophile.description: Means to hold more Great Works than anyone. Likes a civilization that leaves them to her and dislikes one that collects its own.

cradle_of_civilization.name: Cradle of Civilization
cradle_of_civilization.description: Likes to build one of every kind of district, and admires a civilization that spreads itself as broadly.

an_end_to_suffering.name: An End to Suffering
an_end_to_suffering.description: Likes a civilization with many Holy Sites and populous cities, and dislikes one lacking in either.

kaitiakitanga.name: Kaitiakitanga
kaitiakitanga.description: Keeps the natural features of his land and builds National Parks. Likes a civilization that respects the environment.

narikala_fortress.name: Narikala Fortress
narikala_fortress.description: Puts high walls around her cities and respects a civilization that fortifies its own. Dislikes one that leaves its cities open.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: Likes a leader who has declared a Surprise War, and dismisses one who never does.

black_queen.name: Black Queen
black_queen.description: Gathers as many Spies and as much diplomatic sight as she can, and thinks little of a civilization that ignores espionage.
